assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Capability to draft the requested scene in close third-person with sensory detail and subtext-driven dialogue.
assessments.rationale: This skill explicitly designs plot architecture and says not to write scene prose, so it cannot produce the requested 1,100-word scene.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Capability to write a mystery-novel scene with the requested narrative perspective, conflict, and craft notes.
assessments.rationale: The skill is for short B2B cold-email copy and follow-ups, not fiction-scene drafting.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Capability to write a mystery-novel scene with close-third narration, dialogue, and a dramatic turn.
assessments.rationale: The skill facilitates sprint retrospectives and action items; it provides no fiction-writing workflow.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Capability to draft a brand-new fiction scene from the supplied premise.
assessments.rationale: This skill revises fiction prose that already exists and explicitly excludes drafting a new scene from nothing.
It directly writes individual fiction scenes with goal-conflict-turn structure, sensory grounding, interiority, and subtext-driven dialogue, then reports the turn and a craft choice.
